text.description_html:
19-5/8" Long Contemporary Door Pull

This contemporary 1" diameter door pull can be used in many applications such as:

  • Entrance and Patio Doors
  • Appliances, such as Refrigerators and Freezers
  • Glass Doors, such as on Showers or Storefront doors
  • Just about anywhere a door pull is needed.

These 19-5/8" long contemporary door pulls are very high quality and available in your choice of Satin Nickel or Polished Chrome finish.

Specifications of First Impressions 3245/500-CUSTOM Contemporary Door Pull

  • Total Length: 19-5/8" (500 mm)
  • Center to Center Mounting: 15-3/4" (400 mm)
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Pull Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Bracket Diameter: 3/4"
  • Material: Solid Aluminum Bar Stock

Packaged standard for Thrubolt Mounting (bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back Mounting (2 door pulls attached to each other) kits are available. Note: Back to Back Mounting Requires 2 pulls. Order 2 Pulls.

Sold individually.
